CustomField.description: Per-item deal phase, overriding the phase on this row group. BLANK MEANS INHERIT FROM Task_Group_Def__mdt.Stage__c, which is the normal case for all 82 rows today - every current item takes its phase from its group. The column exists so a single item that belongs to a different phase than its group can be expressed as data instead of a special case in the fan-out. Free text, because a Custom Metadata Type field cannot reference another object picklist, so the value must match Transaction__c.Stage__c EXACTLY including the hyphen in Post-Closing; a typo produces an invalid restricted-picklist value and the insert is rejected at DML, not coerced.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave blank to inherit the phase from the group. Only set it when one item belongs to a different phase, and match the deal Stage value exactly.
CustomField.label: Stage Override
